I live on one of the Great Lakes and get a lot of debris on our beach. A huge log washed up, and I used my Vevor 62cc Chainsaw (another 5-star tool) to cut it up. However, some pieces of the log required an additional cut because they are 200lbs to 350lbs. I didn't move them in time, and a storm came in and buried each log in the sand, making them very difficult to move. I purchased the Timberjack hoping I could unbury the logs, and guess what. First thing I noticed was the weight. It's about 20lbs. Very beefy, but very easy to put together and use. The Timberjack is a manual tool, and you'll be doing the work yourself. That being said, it worked like a charm! In fact, it exceeded my expectations. The Timberjack delivered! From the sand, I unburied some very heavy logs and moved them into a space to dry. I did lose one of the foot black end caps in the process of doing this work, and there are multiple scratches, but that's to be expected when using this tool. Overall, I highly recommend the Timberjack because it does the heavy lifting for you, which saves your back and protects you from injury, which is priceless.
